summary: Locked file-position query wrapper. Acquires the stream critical section on the stream handle, queries the current file tell/seek position through FileTellSeekPositionQuery, releases the critical section, and returns the queried position. A thin lock/unlock guard around a single position query; on the frame path via binary/resource/audio readers.

local_names.a1: stream handle/object carrying the critical section and file cursor
local_names.a2: first position-query argument forwarded to FileTellSeekPositionQuery
local_names.a3: second position-query argument forwarded to FileTellSeekPositionQuery
local_names.v3: returned file position value from the query

operations.description: Acquires the stream critical section via StreamBufferLockViaCriticalSection on the stream handle a1 before the position query
Queries the current file tell/seek position via FileTellSeekPositionQuery(a1, a2, a3) and stores the result in v3
Releases the stream critical section via AddressRangeCriticalSectionLeave(a1) after the query completes
Returns the queried file position value stored in v3
Serves as the locked position-query wrapper for binary/resource readers such as BinaryDataDeserialization and AudioStreamBufferRead

unresolved: The exact meaning of a2/a3 depends on FileTellSeekPositionQuery's relative/absolute seek semantics, which are outside this packet
